label: Bogurar doi
note: Sweetened doi from Bogura (Sherpur upazila), Bangladesh; GI-tagged (certificate issued 25 June, reported as 2023; sources differ on the year). Set in earthen pots, which pottery in Bogura largely lives off.

about.text: Sweet doi from Bogura in northern Bangladesh, sold in earthen pots; it received a Geographical Indication tag. Bogura makes about 50 tonnes a day in around 400 factories, per the Financial Express.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.
